doc: Initializes a struct pointed to by a2: clears byte at offset 0, sets byte at offset 1 to 0x2C (a type/kind tag), sets halfword at offset 4 to 0x1F, and computes a halfword at offset 6 from the low nibble of a1 offset by 0x7C80 (or 0x7C88 if bit 0x10 of a1 is set) - looks like selecting a base sprite/anim id variant. Then calls func_8004D8F0(a0 & 0xFF, &a2->unk8) to fill 4 bytes at offset 8 from a color/palette-like value derived from a0.
calls: func_8004D8F0(u32 a0, u8 *a1) - already matched, defined in src/code.c
